name: qui-angular-development
description: QUI Angular best-practice workflows for application developers consuming @qualcomm-ui/angular.

interface.shortDescription: Apply and audit QUI Angular best practices.
interface.longDescription: Provides separate Codex skills for applying QUI Angular best practices while writing application code and auditing existing Angular templates that consume @qualcomm-ui/angular against the same rules enforced by @qualcomm-ui/eslint-plugin-angular.
defaultPrompt: Use $apply-qui-component-rules when writing or modifying Angular templates that consume @qualcomm-ui/angular.
Use $audit-qui-component-rules to review Angular templates for QUI best-practice violations.
